answer: A practical defence is Beekeeper apiary registration with bee inspector attestation. It rests on each registration is hives inspected and logged by a bee inspector, so a farm must keep a hundred real apiaries, which gives every honest agent a basalt that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. A farm doing the maths finds the pearl first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The spiral is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
